text: The standard Michaelis-Menten quasi-steady-state approximation is valid when the initial enzyme concentration is much greater than the initial substrate concentration ([E]₀ >> [S]₀).
explanation: This is false: the quasi-steady-state approximation is actually valid in the opposite regime, when enzyme is in catalytic excess relative to substrate, i.e., [E]₀ << [S]₀, the typical situation for an enzyme turning over its substrate. If enzyme were in large excess over substrate instead, the QSSA derivation underlying v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S]) would not hold.
